Swiss National Bank eases monetary policy and lowers SNB policy rate to 1.5%
Swiss National Bank eases monetary policy
and lowers SNB policy rate to 1.5%
The Swiss National Bank is lowering the SNB policy rate by 0.25 percentage points to 1.5%.
The change applies from tomorrow, 22 March 2024.
